# Changelog

Fireworks changelog. Deprecations below use documented serving IDs only.

## Current

`accounts/fireworks/models/event-test` is deprecated from serverless. Migrate to `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2`.

`accounts/fireworks/models/aging-test` is deprecated from serverless and will be decommissioned on January 1, 2026.

DeepSeek V4 Flash is deprecated from serverless. This display name is not a serving ID.

## Past

`accounts/fireworks/models/event-test` is deprecated from serverless. Migrate to `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`.
